invariants: the command targets the sole administrator or explicitly restores the configured owner only when no administrator exists
password input is interactive and is never accepted as a command-line argument
every successful recovery advances auth_version and revokes all older sessions
every successful recovery removes the TOTP credential and recovery hashes, consumes active challenges, and requires a new TOTP enrollment
the target account is active, remains the only administrator, and must change the recovery password after login
the password hash and the maintenance record are committed in the same transaction
stdout and the maintenance record never contain plaintext passwords, TOTP secrets, recovery codes, tokens, database credentials, or health values
multiple-administrator state, wrong-target confirmation, weak password, or a failed integrity check causes a full rollback
